<style>
img.emoji{height:1em!important;width:1em!important;margin:0 .05em 0 .1em!important;vertical-align:-.1em!important;display:inline!important}
.as-page{
  --as-bg:#F8FAFD;
  --as-bg-card:#fff;
  --as-bg-card-hover:#f1f5f9;
  --as-bg-elevated:#fff;
  --as-text:#0f172a;
  --as-muted:#64748b;
  --as-border:#e5e7eb;
  --as-border-strong:#cbd5e1;
  --as-glass:rgba(0,0,0,.02);
  --as-glass-border:#e5e7eb;
  background:var(--as-bg);color:var(--as-text);
}

/* ═══ SKELETON LOADING ═══ */
.as-skeleton{background:#e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.as-skeleton::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent);animation:as-shimmer 1.5s infinite}
@keyframes as-shimmer{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}100%{transform:translateX(100%)}}
.as-skel-card{height:200px;border-radius:12px}
.as-skel-row{height:48px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.as-skel-text{height:14px;border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:8px}
.as-skel-text.w-60{width:60%}.as-skel-text.w-40{width:40%}.as-skel-text.w-80{width:80%}

/* Subnav links — light */
.as-subnav-links a{color:#64748b;text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.as-subnav-links a:hover{background:rgba(0,98,204,.08);color:#0062CC}
.as-subnav-links a.active{background:rgba(0,98,204,.08);color:#0062CC}

/* Hero — gradient stays dark for contrast */
.as-hero{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#000B1A 0%,#001233 35%,#001845 55%,#000B1A 100%);color:#fff}
.as-hero::before{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 20%,rgba(0,98,204,.15),transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 80% 80%,rgba(52,170,255,.15),transparent),linear-gradient(160deg,#000B1A 0%,#001233 35%,#001845 55%,#000B1A 100%)}
.as-hero h1{color:#fff}
.as-hero h1 span{-webkit-text-fill-color:unset;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4DA3FF,#34AAFF);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.as-hero-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.65)}
.as-hero-stat-val{-webkit-text-fill-color:unset;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4DA3FF,#34AAFF);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.as-hero-stat-label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}

/* Sections — light */
.as-section{background:var(--as-bg)}
.as-section:nth-child(even){background:#fff}
.as-section-title{color:#0f172a}

/* Live cards — light */
.as-live-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.as-live-card:hover{border-color:var(--as-primary-border);box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,98,204,.12);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.as-live-name{color:#0f172a}
.as-live-meta{color:#64748b}

/* Creator cards — light */
.as-creator-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.as-creator-card:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,98,204,.12);border-color:var(--as-primary-border)}
.as-creator-name{color:#0f172a}
.as-creator-country{color:#64748b}
.as-creator-stat-val{color:#0f172a;display:block;margin-bottom:2px}
.as-creator-stat-label{color:#94a3b8;display:block;font-size:.6rem;margin-top:2px}

/* Table — light */
.as-rank-table-wrap{border:1px solid #e5e7eb;background:#fff;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;border-radius:12px}
.as-rank-table{min-width:700px}
.as-rank-table th{background:#f8fafd;color:#64748b;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e7eb;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:background .15s,color .15s;white-space:nowrap}
.as-rank-table th:hover{background:#eef2f7;color:#0f172a}
.as-rank-table th.sorted{color:var(--as-primary)}
.as-rank-table th .sort-arrow{display:inline-block;margin-left:4px;font-size:.6rem;opacity:.4;transition:opacity .15s}
.as-rank-table th.sorted .sort-arrow{opacity:1;color:var(--as-primary)}
.as-rank-table td{border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;color:#0f172a}
.as-rank-table tr:hover td{background:#f8fafd}
.as-table-user-name{color:#0f172a}

/* News — light */
.as-news-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.as-news-card:hover{border-color:var(--as-primary-border);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,98,204,.1);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.as-news-title{color:#0f172a}
.as-news-excerpt{color:#64748b}

/* Calendar — light */
.as-cal-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.as-cal-card:hover{border-color:var(--as-primary-border);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,98,204,.08)}
.as-cal-title{color:#0f172a}
.as-cal-date{background:#E8F2FF}
.as-cal-date-month{color:var(--as-primary)}
.as-cal-date-day{color:#0f172a}

/* Explain/feature — light */
.as-feature-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.as-feature-card:hover{border-color:var(--as-primary-border);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,98,204,.1);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.as-feature-title{color:#0f172a}
.as-feature-desc{color:#64748b}
.as-explain-title{color:#0f172a;font-family:var(--as-font-body)}
.as-explain-sub{color:#64748b}

/* Feature icon — SVG container */
.as-feature-icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:16px;flex-shrink:0}
.as-feature-icon svg{width:24px;height:24px}

/* FAQ — light */
.as-faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid #e5e7eb}
button.as-faq-q{background:none;border:none;width:100%;text-align:left;font-family:inherit;font-size:inherit;padding:inherit;margin:0}
.as-faq-q{color:#0f172a}
.as-faq-q::after{color:#94a3b8}
.as-faq-a{color:#64748b}

/* Filter chips — light */
.as-chip{background:#f1f5f9;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;color:#64748b;cursor:pointer;min-height:36px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.as-chip:hover{border-color:var(--as-primary-border);color:#0f172a}
.as-chip.active{background:var(--as-primary);border-color:var(--as-primary);color:#fff}

/* Category pill — light */
.as-category{background:#f1f5f9;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;color:#64748b}

/* Platform badges — with SVG icons */
.as-platform{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.as-platform svg{flex-shrink:0;vertical-align:middle}
.as-platform-yt{background:rgba(255,0,0,.08);color:#dc2626}
.as-platform-twitch{background:rgba(145,70,255,.1);color:#9146FF}
.as-platform-tiktok{background:rgba(0,0,0,.06);color:#0f172a}
.as-platform-ig{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(131,58,180,.08),rgba(253,29,29,.08),rgba(252,176,69,.08));color:#c13584}
.as-platform-kick{background:rgba(83,252,24,.1);color:#16a34a}
.as-platform-rumble{background:rgba(133,208,69,.1);color:#558b2f}

/* Stat cards in hero — keep glassmorphism */
.as-hero-stat-val{font-size:1.5rem}

/* Outline button — light variant */
.as-btn-outline{border-color:#cbd5e1;color:#0f172a}
.as-btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--as-primary);color:var(--as-primary)}

/* Footer override for light bg */
.as-page afro-footer{--color-bg-dark:#0f172a}

/* ═══ Creator profile cards — richer info ═══ */
.as-creator-card .as-creator-subs{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--as-primary);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px}
.as-creator-card .as-creator-type{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;background:#f1f5f9;color:#64748b;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:6px;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:12px}
.as-creator-card .as-creator-links{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.as-creator-card .as-creator-links a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:600;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:980px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;color:#64748b;transition:all .15s}
.as-creator-card .as-creator-links a:hover{border-color:var(--as-primary);color:var(--as-primary)}
.as-profile-btn:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,98,204,.35);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.as-profile-btn:hover span{transform:translateX(3px)}

/* ═══ Rank table subs column ═══ */
.as-rank-table .as-subs-cell{font-weight:600;color:var(--as-primary)}

/* Product lanes and streamer board */
.as-lane-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.as-lane-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:18px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.06);text-decoration:none;color:inherit;min-height:172px;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s,transform .15s}
.as-lane-card:hover{border-color:var(--as-primary-border);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,98,204,.1);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.as-lane-kicker{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--as-primary)}
.as-lane-title{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:800;color:#0f172a}
.as-lane-desc{font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.55;color:#64748b}
.as-lane-cta{margin-top:auto;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--as-primary)}
.as-streamer-board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.as-streamer-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.05);text-decoration:none;color:inherit;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s,transform .15s}
.as-streamer-row:hover{border-color:var(--as-primary-border);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,98,204,.1);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.as-streamer-rank{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:#f1f5f9;color:#0f172a;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.8rem}
.as-streamer-avatar{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;font-weight:800;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;background-size:cover;background-position:center;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.as-streamer-name{font-weight:800;color:#0f172a;margin-bottom:3px}
.as-streamer-meta{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#64748b;font-size:.76rem}
.as-streamer-score{text-align:right}
.as-streamer-score strong{display:block;color:var(--as-primary);font-size:1.05rem}
.as-streamer-score span{display:block;color:#94a3b8;font-size:.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.as-empty-card{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:34px 24px;color:#64748b;background:#fff;border:1px dashed #cbd5e1;border-radius:14px}
.as-empty-card strong{display:block;color:#0f172a;font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.as-empty-card p{margin:0 auto 14px;max-width:520px;font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.55}
.as-empty-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.as-empty-actions button,.as-empty-actions a{border:1px solid #cbd5e1;background:#f8fafc;color:#0f172a;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}
.as-empty-actions button:hover,.as-empty-actions a:hover{border-color:var(--as-primary);color:var(--as-primary)}

/* ═══ AfroScore & Tier badges ═══ */
.as-afro-score{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin:12px 0 8px;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9}
.as-score-num{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:800;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0062CC,#34AAFF);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.as-score-label{font-size:.6rem;color:#94a3b8;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.as-score-badge{font-weight:700;color:var(--as-primary)}
.as-tier{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:100px;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.as-tier-legend{background:rgba(234,179,8,.12);color:#b45309}
.as-tier-elite{background:rgba(139,92,246,.1);color:#7c3aed}
.as-tier-established{background:rgba(0,98,204,.08);color:#0062CC}
.as-tier-trending{background:rgba(16,185,129,.1);color:#059669}
.as-tier-rising{background:rgba(148,163,184,.1);color:#64748b}

/* ═══ Emoji sizing — prevent twemoji from breaking layout ═══ */
.as-chip img.emoji,.as-filter-row img.emoji,.as-live-meta img.emoji,.as-creator-card img.emoji,
.as-platform img.emoji,.as-category img.emoji,.as-cal-meta img.emoji{
  height:.85em!important;width:.85em!important;vertical-align:-.1em!important;margin:0 2px 0 0!important;display:inline!important
}
.as-live-thumb img.emoji,.as-news-thumb img.emoji,.as-avatar img.emoji,.as-feature-icon img.emoji{
  height:1.5em!important;width:1.5em!important;vertical-align:middle!important;display:inline!important
}

/* ═══ ACCESSIBILITY — focus-visible states ═══ */
.as-live-card:focus-visible,.as-creator-card:focus-visible,.as-news-card:focus-visible,
.as-cal-card:focus-visible,.as-feature-card:focus-visible,.as-chip:focus-visible,
.as-btn:focus-visible,.as-faq-q:focus-visible,.as-profile-btn:focus-visible,
.as-subnav-links a:focus-visible,.as-section-link:focus-visible{
  outline:2px solid var(--as-primary);outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,98,204,.15)
}
.as-rank-table tr:focus-visible td{outline:2px solid var(--as-primary);outline-offset:-2px}
.as-faq-q{cursor:pointer}
.as-chip{cursor:pointer}

/* ═══ prefers-reduced-motion ═══ */
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .as-hero::after{animation:none!important}
  .as-live-badge::before{animation:none!important}
  .as-pulse-dot{animation:none!important}
  .as-animate-in{animation:none!important;opacity:1!important}
  .as-live-card,.as-creator-card,.as-news-card,.as-cal-card,.as-feature-card,.as-btn,.as-chip,.as-profile-btn{transition:none!important}
  .as-skeleton::after{animation:none!important}
}

@media(max-width:900px){
  .as-lane-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .as-streamer-board{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

/* ═══ Responsive tweaks for light mode ═══ */
@media(max-width:640px){
  .as-header{background:rgba(255,255,255,.96)}
  /* Hero grid animation off on mobile for perf */
  .as-hero::after{animation:none}
  /* Subnav scroll */
  .as-subnav{overflow:visible!important}
  .as-subnav-inner{gap:12px;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:none;padding-right:12px}
  .as-subnav-inner::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .as-subnav-links{display:flex!important;flex-shrink:0}
  .as-subnav-links a{padding:6px 12px;font-size:.75rem}
  .as-subnav .as-subnav-logo{font-size:1.05rem}
  .as-subnav-inner>div:last-child{display:none!important}
  /* Filter rows — ensure scroll works */
  .as-filters{overflow:visible}
  .as-filter-row{-ms-overflow-style:none}
  .as-chip{padding:4px 10px;font-size:.72rem;min-height:32px}
  /* Section containers — prevent horizontal page overflow */
  .as-section{overflow-x:hidden}
  .as-container{overflow-x:visible}
  /* Platform badges in cards — compact */
  .as-platform{font-size:.65rem!important;padding:2px 6px}
  .as-category{font-size:.65rem!important;padding:2px 6px}
  /* Live cards — prevent overflow */
  .as-live-grid{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:none;padding-bottom:8px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory}
  .as-live-grid::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .as-live-card{min-width:260px;scroll-snap-align:start}
  /* Creator cards — single column */
  .as-creator-featured-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  /* Rank table — scrollable + smaller text */
  .as-rank-table{font-size:.72rem}
  .as-rank-table th,.as-rank-table td{padding:8px 6px}
  .as-rank-table-wrap{margin-left:-20px;margin-right:-20px;border-radius:0;border-left:0;border-right:0}
  .as-lane-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .as-streamer-row{grid-template-columns:auto auto 1fr}

      peak: Math.max(byCreatorId && byCreatorId.peak || 0, byCreatorName && byCreatorName.peak || 0),

      platforms: Object.assign({}, byCreatorId && byCreatorId.platforms || {}, byCreatorName && byCreatorName.platforms || {})
    };
    if(!own.count && !isLivePlatformCreator(cr)) return;
    var score = Math.min(100, Math.round((own.live ? 18 : 0) + Math.min(32, own.count * 8) + Math.min(24, own.peak / 120) + Math.min(18, (cr.followers || 0) / 50000) + (isLivePlatformCreator(cr) ? 8 : 0)));
    leaders.push({
      creator: cr,
      count: own.count,
      peak: own.peak,
      live: own.live,
      url: own.url,
      score: Math.max(1, score),
      platforms: Object.keys(own.platforms).length ? Object.keys(own.platforms) : (cr.platforms || [cr.platform])
    });
  });
  leaders.sort(function(a,b){
    return b.score - a.score || b.count - a.count || b.peak - a.peak || (b.creator.followers || 0) - (a.creator.followers || 0);
  });
  return leaders;
}

function extractYouTubeVideoId(value){
  if(!value) return '';
  var str = String(value).trim();
  if(!str) return '';
  if(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(str)) return str;
  var patterns = [
    /[?&]v=([A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})/i,
    /youtu\.be\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})/i,
    /youtube\.com\/(?:live|shorts|embed)\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})/i
  ];
  for(var i=0;i<patterns.length;i++){
    var match = str.match(patterns[i]);
    if(match) return match[1];
  }
  return '';
}

function normalizeThumbnailUrl(value){
  if(!value) return '';
  if(Array.isArray(value)){
    for(var i=0;i<value.length;i++){
      var arrUrl = normalizeThumbnailUrl(value[i]);
      if(arrUrl) return arrUrl;
    }
    return '';
  }
  if(typeof value === 'object'){
    var keys = ['url','src','secure_url','thumbnail_url','thumbnailUrl','image','thumbnail','poster','original','large','medium','small','sm'];
    for(var k=0;k<keys.length;k++){
      var objUrl = normalizeThumbnailUrl(value[keys[k]]);
      if(objUrl) return objUrl;
    }
    return '';
  }
  var str = String(value).trim();
  if(!str || str==='null' || str==='undefined' || str==='[object Object]') return '';
  if((str.charAt(0)==='{' || str.charAt(0)==='[') && str.indexOf('http')!==0){
    try { return normalizeThumbnailUrl(JSON.parse(str)); } catch(e) {}
  }
  str = str
    .replace(/\\u0026/g,'&')
    .replace(/\\\//g,'/')
    .replace(/&/g,'&')
    .replace(/^\/\//,'https://')
    .replace(/^http:\/\//i,'https://')
    .replace(/\{width\}/g,'440')
    .replace(/\{height\}/g,'248');
  return /^https?:\/\//i.test(str) ? str : '';
}

    if(url.origin === location.origin) return true;

function buildSourceLanes(data, health, healthError){
  if(isStaticPreviewHost()){
    return {
      streams: laneHealth('preview', 'Showing sample streams on this preview.'),
      rankings: laneHealth('preview', 'Showing sample rankings on this preview.'),
      news: laneHealth('preview', 'Showing sample news on this preview.'),
      calendar: laneHealth('preview', 'Showing sample schedule on this preview.')
    };
  }

  data = data || {};
  var streamsLoaded = !!(data.streams && Array.isArray(data.streams.live));
  var calendarLoaded = !!(data.streams && Array.isArray(data.streams.upcoming));
  var creatorsLoaded = Array.isArray(data.creators);
  var fallbackCreator = creatorsLoaded && data.creators.filter(function(creator){
    return creator && creator._raw && creator._raw.source_state === 'fallback';
  })[0];
  var creatorsFallback = !!fallbackCreator;
  var fallbackSnapshot = fallbackCreator && fallbackCreator._raw && fallbackCreator._raw.source_snapshot_label || 'archived seed snapshot';
  var newsLoaded = Array.isArray(data.news);
  var lanes = {
    streams: streamsLoaded
      ? laneHealth('live', (data.streams.live.length || 0) + ' live streams loaded.')
      : laneHealth('unavailable', 'Live streams could not be loaded right now.'),
    rankings: creatorsFallback
      ? laneHealth('stale', data.creators.length + ' archived sample creators shown (' + fallbackSnapshot + '). Audience metrics are not freshness-verified.')
      : creatorsLoaded && data.creators.length
      ? laneHealth('live', data.creators.length + ' creators loaded.')
      : laneHealth('unavailable', 'Creator rankings could not be loaded right now.'),
    news: newsLoaded
      ? laneHealth(data.news.length ? 'live' : 'stale', data.news.length ? data.news.length + ' news items loaded.' : 'No news to show yet.')
      : laneHealth('unavailable', 'News could not be loaded right now.'),
    calendar: calendarLoaded
      ? laneHealth('live', (data.streams.upcoming.length || 0) + ' upcoming streams loaded.')
      : laneHealth('unavailable', 'The schedule could not be loaded right now.')
  };

  if(healthError || !health){
    Object.keys(lanes).forEach(function(key){
      if(lanes[key].status === 'live'){
        lanes[key] = laneHealth('unavailable', 'Data loaded, but we could not confirm how fresh it is.');
      }
    });
    return lanes;
  }

  var syncRun = health.automation && health.automation.sync;
  var liveRun = health.automation && health.automation.livecheck;
  var newsRun = health.automation && health.automation.news_monitor;
  var snapshotAge = health.snapshots && (health.snapshots.age_days != null ? health.snapshots.age_days : sourceDaysAgo(health.snapshots.latest_snapshot_date));
  var syncAge = sourceHoursAgo(syncRun && syncRun.fetched_at);
  var liveRunAge = sourceHoursAgo(liveRun && liveRun.fetched_at);
  var latestStreamAge = health.streams && (health.streams.latest_updated_age_hours != null ? health.streams.latest_updated_age_hours : sourceHoursAgo(health.streams.latest_updated_at));
  var latestNewsAge = health.news && (health.news.latest_age_hours != null ? health.news.latest_age_hours : sourceHoursAgo(health.news.latest_published_at));

  if(creatorsFallback){
    lanes.rankings = laneHealth('stale', data.creators.length + ' archived sample creators shown (' + fallbackSnapshot + '). Audience metrics are not freshness-verified.');
  } else if(isBlockedRun(syncRun)){
    lanes.rankings = laneHealth('blocked', 'Latest creator sync reported a failed source run.');
  } else if(creatorsLoaded && data.creators.length && (snapshotAge == null || snapshotAge > 2 || syncAge == null || syncAge > 6)){
    lanes.rankings = laneHealth('stale', 'Latest ranking snapshot is ' + (snapshotAge == null ? 'not dated' : snapshotAge + 'd old') + '.');
  } else if(creatorsLoaded && data.creators.length && health.creators && health.creators.published){
    lanes.rankings = laneHealth('live', health.creators.published + ' published creators; ranking source refreshed recently.');
  }

  if(isBlockedRun(liveRun)){
    lanes.streams = laneHealth('blocked', 'Latest live stream check reported a failed source run.');
  } else if(streamsLoaded && (liveRunAge == null || liveRunAge > 1.5 || latestStreamAge == null || latestStreamAge > 3)){
    lanes.streams = laneHealth('stale', 'Live stream source last refreshed ' + (formatAge(liveRunAge || latestStreamAge) || 'outside the freshness window') + '.');
  } else if(streamsLoaded && health.streams){
    var visibleLive = data.streams.live.length;
    var checkedLive = Number(health.streams.live_now || 0);
    lanes.streams = visibleLive === checkedLive
      ? laneHealth('live', visibleLive + ' live streams shown; ' + (health.streams.last_24h || 0) + ' stream rows in 24h.')
      : laneHealth('stale', visibleLive + ' live streams shown; the latest source check marked ' + checkedLive + '. Live status needs another check.');
  }

  if(isBlockedRun(newsRun)){
    lanes.news = laneHealth('blocked', 'Latest news monitor reported a failed source run.');
  } else if(newsLoaded && health.sources && (health.sources.stale_over_7d || 0) > 0 && !(health.sources.success_last_24h || 0)){
    lanes.news = laneHealth('stale', 'No source success in 24h; ' + health.sources.stale_over_7d + ' news sources are stale.');
  } else if(newsLoaded && latestNewsAge != null && latestNewsAge > 168){
    lanes.news = laneHealth('stale', 'Latest published news is ' + formatAge(latestNewsAge) + '.');
  } else if(newsLoaded && health.news){
    lanes.news = laneHealth('live', (health.news.total_published || data.news.length || 0) + ' published news items checked.');
  }

  if(isBlockedRun(liveRun)){
    lanes.calendar = laneHealth('blocked', 'Calendar uses the stream source, and the latest live check failed.');
  } else if(calendarLoaded && (latestStreamAge == null || latestStreamAge > 24)){
    lanes.calendar = laneHealth('stale', 'Calendar stream source last updated ' + (formatAge(latestStreamAge) || 'outside the freshness window') + '.');
  } else if(calendarLoaded){
    lanes.calendar = laneHealth('live', (data.streams.upcoming.length || 0) + ' upcoming rows; stream source checked ' + (formatAge(latestStreamAge) || 'recently') + '.');
  }

  return lanes;
}

function copyTextToClipboard(text){
  if(navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext){
    return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
  }
  var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
  ta.value = text;
  ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
  ta.style.position = 'fixed';
  ta.style.top = '-999px';
  document.body.appendChild(ta);
  ta.select();
  var ok = document.execCommand('copy');
  document.body.removeChild(ta);
  return ok ? Promise.resolve() : Promise.reject(new Error('Copy command unavailable'));
}

/* ---------- FILTERS ---------- */

var activeTime = 'All-Time Reach';
var activeCat  = 'All';
var activeCountry = 'All';

function renderFilters(){
  var times = ['All-Time Reach'];
  document.getElementById('timeFilter').innerHTML = times.map(function(t){
    var isActive = activeTime===t;
    return '<button type="button" class="as-chip'+(isActive?' active':'')+'" data-filter="time" data-val="'+t+'" role="radio" aria-checked="'+(isActive?'true':'false')+'">'+t+'</button>';
  }).join('');

  var cats = ['All'].concat(CATEGORIES);
  document.getElementById('catFilter').innerHTML = cats.map(function(c,i){
    var icon = i>0 ? CAT_ICONS[i-1]+' ' : '';
    var isActive = activeCat===c;
    return '<button type="button" class="as-chip'+(isActive?' active':'')+'" data-filter="cat" data-val="'+c+'" role="radio" aria-checked="'+(isActive?'true':'false')+'">'+icon+c+'</button>';
  }).join('');

  var isAllCountry = activeCountry==='All';
  var html = '<button type="button" class="as-chip'+(isAllCountry?' active':'')+'" data-filter="country" data-val="All" role="radio" aria-checked="'+(isAllCountry?'true':'false')+'">All Countries</button>';
  COUNTRIES.forEach(function(c){
    var isActive = activeCountry===c.name;
    html += '<button type="button" class="as-chip'+(isActive?' active':'')+'" data-filter="country" data-val="'+c.name+'" role="radio" aria-checked="'+(isActive?'true':'false')+'">'+c.flag+' '+c.name+'</button>';
  });
  document.getElementById('countryFilter').innerHTML = html;

  document.querySelectorAll('.as-chip').forEach(function(chip){
    chip.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var type = this.dataset.filter;
      var val  = this.dataset.val;
      if(type==='time')    activeTime = val;
      if(type==='cat')     activeCat = val;
      if(type==='country') activeCountry = val;
      applyFilters();
      renderFilters();
    });
  });
}

function applyFilters(){
  var filtered = CREATORS.filter(function(cr){
    if(activeCat!=='All' && (CATEGORIES[cr.cat]||'')!==activeCat) return false;
    if(activeCountry!=='All' && (COUNTRIES[cr.country]||COUNTRY_FALLBACK).name!==activeCountry) return false;
    return true;
  });
  renderTopThree(filtered);
  renderRankTable(filtered);
  renderStreamerBoard();
}

function clearCreatorFilters(){
  activeTime = 'All-Time Reach';
  activeCat = 'All';
  activeCountry = 'All';

/* ---------- TABLE SORT ---------- */

(function(){
  var headers = document.querySelectorAll('.as-rank-table th');
  var sortCol = -1, sortAsc = false;
  var colKeys = [null,null,null,null,null,'score','followers','views','nw'];

  headers.forEach(function(th, idx){
    if(!colKeys[idx]) return;
    th.style.cursor = 'pointer';
    th.setAttribute('aria-sort', 'none');
    th.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var key = colKeys[idx];
      if(sortCol===idx){ sortAsc=!sortAsc; } else { sortCol=idx; sortAsc=false; }
      // Update visual indicators
      headers.forEach(function(h){ h.classList.remove('sorted'); h.setAttribute('aria-sort','none'); var arr=h.querySelector('.sort-arrow'); if(arr) arr.innerHTML='▼'; });
      this.classList.add('sorted');
      this.setAttribute('aria-sort', sortAsc ? 'ascending' : 'descending');
      var arrow = this.querySelector('.sort-arrow');
      if(arrow) arrow.innerHTML = sortAsc ? '▲' : '▼';
      var sorted = CREATORS.filter(function(cr){
        if(activeCat!=='All' && (CATEGORIES[cr.cat]||'')!==activeCat) return false;
        if(activeCountry!=='All' && (COUNTRIES[cr.country]||COUNTRY_FALLBACK).name!==activeCountry) return false;
        return true;
      }).sort(function(a,b){
        return sortAsc ? a[key]-b[key] : b[key]-a[key];
      });
      renderTopThree(sorted);
      renderRankTable(sorted);
      renderStreamerBoard();
    });
  });
})();


/* ---------- ASYNC DATA LOADING ---------- */

async function init() {
  renderHeroStats();
  renderFeatures();
  renderFAQ();

  var loadedData = null;
  var sourceHealth = null;
  var sourceHealthError = null;

  // Try loading from the deployed public APIs; localhost keeps a static preview.
  if (window.AfroStreamEngine && !isStaticPreviewHost()) {
    try {
      var data = await AfroStreamEngine.loadAll();
      loadedData = data;
      AFROSTREAM_LOAD_STATE.creators = Array.isArray(data.creators) ? 'available' : 'unavailable';
      AFROSTREAM_LOAD_STATE.streams = data.streams && Array.isArray(data.streams.live) ? 'available' : 'unavailable';
      AFROSTREAM_LOAD_STATE.calendar = data.streams && Array.isArray(data.streams.upcoming) ? 'available' : 'unavailable';
      AFROSTREAM_LOAD_STATE.news = Array.isArray(data.news) ? 'available' : 'unavailable';

      if (data.creators && data.creators.length) {
        CREATORS.length = 0;
        data.creators.forEach(function(c){ CREATORS.push(hydrateCreatorRuntimeMetrics(c)); });
      }
      if (data.streams) {
        if (data.streams.live && data.streams.live.length) {
          LIVE_STREAMS.length = 0;
          data.streams.live.forEach(function(s){ LIVE_STREAMS.push(hydrateLiveStreamRuntimeMetrics(s)); });
        }
        if (data.streams.upcoming && data.streams.upcoming.length) {
          UPCOMING.length = 0;
          data.streams.upcoming.forEach(function(u){ UPCOMING.push(u); });
        }
      }
      if (data.news && data.news.length) {
        NEWS.length = 0;
        data.news.forEach(function(n){ NEWS.push(n); });
      }

      console.log('[AfroStream] Loaded from Supabase — ' + CREATORS.length + ' creators, ' + LIVE_STREAMS.length + ' live, ' + NEWS.length + ' news');
    } catch(e) {
      loadedData = {};
      AFROSTREAM_LOAD_STATE = { creators:'unavailable', streams:'unavailable', news:'unavailable', calendar:'unavailable' };
    }

    loadSourceHealth().then(function(health){
      sourceHealth = health;
      renderSourceRail('live', { lanes:buildSourceLanes(loadedData, sourceHealth, null) });
    }).catch(function(error){
      sourceHealthError = error;
      renderSourceRail('live', { lanes:buildSourceLanes(loadedData, null, sourceHealthError) });
    });
  }
  renderSourceRail(isStaticPreviewHost() ? 'preview' : 'live', { lanes: buildSourceLanes(loadedData, sourceHealth, sourceHealthError) });

  renderLive(LIVE_STREAMS);
  renderFilters();
  applyFilters();
  renderNews();
  renderCalendar();

  STREAM_HISTORY.length = 0;
  try {
    var streamHistory = await loadStreamHistory();
    streamHistory.forEach(function(s){ STREAM_HISTORY.push(s); });
  } catch(e) {
    LIVE_STREAMS.forEach(function(s){
      STREAM_HISTORY.push({
        creatorId: s._raw && s._raw.creator_id || '',
        name: s.name,
        platform: s.platform,
        date: s.date || s._raw && s._raw.stream_date || '',
        isLive: true,
        viewers: s.viewers || 0,
        peak: s.viewers || 0,
        url: s.url || ''
      });
    });
  }

  renderHeroStats(loadedData);

  applyFilters();
}
